# Aaryan Lath

> Personal portfolio of Aaryan Lath, an aerospace engineering graduate of Purdue University's School of Aeronautics and Astronautics, now a mechanical engineer and product designer at Siemens Smart Infrastructure. He is cofounder of CryptiQ, a post-quantum cryptography startup, and SkyBase Manager at LuftCar. The site covers his projects, research, coursework, student leadership, and resume.

Aaryan completed his BSAAE at Purdue (GPA 3.73) and now works full time at Siemens Smart Infrastructure as a mechanical engineer and product designer. He was an undergraduate teaching assistant for AAE 351 and for AAE 251, Aircraft and Spacecraft Design. His research spans resilient deep space habitats with RETHi and multidisciplinary design optimization for electric aircraft, with an abstract accepted to the AIAA Aviation Forum 2026. He retired as chief engineer of Purdue's SAE Aero Design team, which placed 16th at SAE Aero Design East 2026. CryptiQ (cryptiqsecurity.com) is building through Founders, Inc. Off Season II in San Francisco. The site also hosts Mach 0.96, an AI assistant that answers questions about Aaryan.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.aaryanlath.com/): Overview of personal projects, academia, professional experience including RETHi research, applied engineering projects, achievements, an embedded resume viewer, and the Mach AI assistant
- [Academia](https://www.aaryanlath.com/academia): Purdue AAE coursework, course highlights, and reports
- [Timeline](https://www.aaryanlath.com/timeline): Awards and achievements, including SAE Aero Design East 2026
- [RETHi Research](https://www.aaryanlath.com/research/rethi): Resilient ExtraTerrestrial Habitats Institute work on deep space habitat systems
- [Purdue Aircraft Teams](https://www.aaryanlath.com/activities/purdue-aircraft-teams): SAE Aero Design chief engineer history plus AUVSI SUAS and AIAA Design/Build/Fly competition work
- [Purdue Space Program](https://www.aaryanlath.com/activities/purdue-space-program): Satellites team structures, mechanisms, and thermals work, deputy systems director, and org secretary roles

## Focus Areas

Topic deep-dives at /focus-areas, each grounded in on-site coursework, teams, research, and projects.

- [Focus Areas](https://www.aaryanlath.com/focus-areas): Index of the topic deep-dives below
- [Aerodynamic Design and CFD](https://www.aaryanlath.com/focus-areas/aerodynamic-design): Ahmed body CFD and slant-angle drag sweeps in AAE 412, plus graduate AAE 514 aerodynamics
- [CAD, GD&T and PLM Workflows](https://www.aaryanlath.com/focus-areas/cad-plm): Creo and Siemens NX assemblies, SAP engineering change notices, Teamcenter PLM
- [Multidisciplinary Design Optimization (MDO)](https://www.aaryanlath.com/focus-areas/design-optimization): Modular MDO framework for electric aircraft accepted to AIAA Aviation 2026, graduate AAE 550
- [Systems Engineering and Requirements](https://www.aaryanlath.com/focus-areas/systems-engineering): Requirements at Siemens and Purdue Space Program, RETHi safety trade studies, AAE 418 experiment
- [Advanced Air Mobility and eVTOL Systems](https://www.aaryanlath.com/focus-areas/advanced-air-mobility): LuftCar eVTOL venture, distributed electric propulsion, UAM safety, electric-aircraft MDO
- [Aircraft Design](https://www.aaryanlath.com/focus-areas/aircraft-design): Purdue SAE Aero competition aircraft as Chief Engineer, XFLR5 wing analysis, DBF, AAE 251 mission design
- [Aerospace Propulsion and Engine Systems](https://www.aaryanlath.com/focus-areas/aerospace-propulsion): Distributed electric propulsion survey in AAE 339 and turbofan bypass ratio analysis
- [Structures, Mechanisms and Thermal Design](https://www.aaryanlath.com/focus-areas/structures-mechanisms): CubeSat structural design in Fusion 360, RETHi vibration-isolation FEA, Vectran tensile testing
- [Post-Quantum Cryptography and CryptiQ](https://www.aaryanlath.com/focus-areas/post-quantum-cryptography): Cofounder of CryptiQ, whose product migrates encryption to NIST post-quantum standards

## Projects

- [TurboFan Engine Assembly](https://www.aaryanlath.com/project/turbofan-engine-assembly): Full 3D parametric turbofan assembly in Creo Parametric with bypass ratio optimization, CFD analysis, and GD&T
- [Single Piston Sterling Engine](https://www.aaryanlath.com/project/single-piston-sterling-engine): Mechanical design in Siemens NX with Aras Innovator and Teamcenter

## Ventures

- [CryptiQ](https://cryptiqsecurity.com): Post-quantum cryptography startup where Aaryan is cofounder on a founding team of four, part of Founders, Inc. Off Season II
- [LuftCar](https://www.luftcar.com): Advanced air mobility company where Aaryan is SkyBase Manager; he also designed and built the company website
